actions.description:
Trigger The assassin is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker they can see.

Effect The assassin gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
actions.name: Nimble Dodge
actions.trigger: The assassin is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker they can see.

actions.description:
Requirements The assassin is wielding a piercing or slashing weapon and has a free hand

Effect The assassin applies a poison to the weapon. That poison's DC is increased to 24 if it was lower.
actions.name: Assassin's Poison
actions.requirements: The assassin is wielding a piercing or slashing weapon and has a free hand

actions.description: The assassin Interacts to draw a weapon, then Strikes with that weapon.
actions.name: Quick Draw

actions.description: The assassin isn't Off-Guard to creatures of 8th level or lower that are Hidden, Undetected, flanking or using Surprise Attack.
actions.name: Deny Advantage

actions.description: The assassin deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.
actions.name: Sneak Attack

actions.description: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are Off-Guard to the assassin.
actions.name: Surprise Attack

actions.description: The assassin can move their full speed when Sneaking.
actions.name: Swift Sneak

name: Assassin
publicNotes:
Assassins commit murder, either for pay or due to their belief in a cause, such as a religion or a political movement. Many are members of assassins' guilds: organizations that accept contracts to kill in return for money, favors, or both.

In the underbelly of society, the lawless reign supreme.
